name: – Adam Jarubas – Article 1 – § 1 – point -1; Directive 2003/87/EC – Article 10a – § 1 – sub§ 6 – Am 13
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directive 2003/87/EC as regards revised benchmark values for the heat and fuel benchmarks for the period from 2026 to 2030
part_text: Amendment (-1) in Article 10a, paragraph 1, subparagraph 6 is replaced by the following: "Allowances that are not allocated due to a reduction of free allocation in accordance with the third and fifth subparagraphs of this paragraph shall be used as follows: (a) one third for the purposes of paragraph 2a of this Article; (b) one third to be auctioned in accordance with Article 10 and the revenues generated from the auctioning to be transferred to the Modernisation Fund referred to in Article 10d, with priority being given to support investments aimed at the modernisation and decarbonisation of district heating systems; (c) one third to be transferred to the Innovation Fund referred to in paragraph 8 of this Article.’;"
